command: Run exactly one bounded zero-cost parallel_offline observer dependency-attribution contract preparation. Preserve all unrelated and existing uncommitted work. Verify and bind all four content-addressed inputs. Treat V22 as a permanently retired operational failure and the stored replay as operationally insufficient at 0.0 request-to-phase coverage; do not update dense-device or host-scheduler scientific beliefs. Inspect the current observer event producers and parsers, then prepare a versioned typed contract and deterministic synthetic fixture/oracle for exact request_id, scheduler_iteration_id, CPU and CUDA clock domains plus their mapping, cuda_stream_id, graph_launch_id and graph_node_id boundaries, kernel start/end intervals, and explicit dependency edges scoped to the same request and iteration. Define coverage only from the union of non-overlapping dependency-linked intervals inside an exact request/iteration scope; reject summed kernel durations and timestamp containment. Require stable event IDs, monotonic per-domain timestamps, an explicit clock-map calibration record, referential integrity for every edge, graph and stream linkage for every kernel interval, and no credentials, addresses, commands, paths, stdout, or stderr in scored event payloads. The stock control is the verified stored trace missing all required fields and must fail closed at 0.0 coverage. The candidate fixture must reach at least 0.95 attribution coverage, replay byte-identically twice, and pass mutation controls that remove or cross-wire each required identity, clock mapping, stream, graph boundary, interval, and dependency edge. Prepare focused deterministic tests and the minimum schema/parser/fixture code needed for this offline contract only; do not generate a provider launcher or fresh paid spec. Preserve future STOCK_STARTUP isolation, A1/B1/A2 ordering, observer-off/on/off perturbation gates, frozen quality/correctness and SLO policies, exact raw request/event retention, cost, low-overhead host/GPU telemetry, logs, hashed manifests, observer-bracketed deep profiling, partial-evidence recovery, and verified compute/disk cleanup. Maximum spend is $0.00; timeout is 480 seconds; seed is 47022401. Retain immutable input inventory and hashes, observer-event.schema.json, valid-fixture.jsonl, missing-field-matrix.json, coverage-result.json, mutation-controls.json, command/test logs, result.md, result-record.json, hashes.txt, verification.log, and verification-exit.txt below the supervisor-provided worker output directory; store the evidence and call record --kind result. Run only narrow deterministic Python tests and python3 tools/devex/check.py. Do not inspect or mutate a provider, prepare or admit a paid identity, launch or poll a provider controller, change budget authority, alter any paid-run deadline, commit, or push. If any contract gate fails, retain the operational result, prohibit promotion, and name the exact missing implementation requirement without retrying unchanged work.

director_contract.decision: Kill the existing-trace replay lineage and admit only this offline schema-contract preparation; V22 remains retired and scientific beliefs remain unchanged.
director_contract.falsifier: The candidate contract cannot express every required identity and dependency relation, deterministic fixture coverage is below 0.95, replay bytes differ, referential integrity fails, forbidden sensitive fields appear, or any missing/cross-wired-field mutation is accepted.
director_contract.quality_gate: No model output is produced; frozen quality/correctness policy remains unchanged and no quality claim is permitted.
